{{Top|leg}}
'''Boro Fareed''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He agreed to defect to the Empire, but the Republic learned of his betrayal and [[Battle of the Taspan system|unsuccessfully attempted]] to intercept Fareed's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in the [[Taspan system]].
